name: Kōra (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Kōra town emblem in white: an outlined hexagonal device enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kōra, a town in Shiga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Kōra town emblem — an outlined hexagonal device enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes
